basics.name: Kyle M. Anderson
basics.summary: Technical professional with software development, systems integration, project management, and client-support experience. One of two developers supporting and evolving a tax-integration platform that connects e-commerce, ERP, billing, payment, and financial systems with leading tax providers. Skilled in Python, Django, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, and translating client requirements into practical technical solutions.

work.name: DSTax Technologies
work.summary: Lead developer responsible for building, supporting, and improving a tax-integration platform.
highlights: Develop integrations among e-commerce, ERP, billing, payment, and financial platforms including Acumatica, Chargebee, Sage, Braintree, Magento/Adobe Commerce, WooCommerce, Stripe, and QuickBooks and tax providers including Thomson Reuters, Vertex, Sovos, and SureTax.
Expanded the platform's integration capabilities and improved integration performance and reliability.
Led the transition from the V1 to V2 product, broadening tax-provider support and coordinating migration of production workloads to AWS.
Built and maintained GitLab CI/CD pipelines to improve consistency and efficiency of software deployments.
Designed and automated client-onboarding workflows, reducing manual work and improving operational efficiency.
Partnered with clients and internal stakeholders to gather requirements, troubleshoot technical issues, and design custom solutions.
Implemented Jira for project and ticket management across development and executive teams and consolidated team documentation in Confluence.
Strengthened development-team security practices by introducing 1Password for password management.
Served as Lead Developer and Project Manager from 2022 to 2026 and trained a developer intern in 2023.

work.name: Colectivo Coffee Roasters
highlights: Weighed and packaged roasted coffee and tea and fulfilled orders for more than 300 restaurant customers.
Updated invoices for inventory changes to help maintain accurate records.
Partnered with the IT department to install and troubleshoot new point-of-sale nodes.
Assisted with training new warehouse hires in 2020.

work.name: Komatsu Mining Corp. (Joy Global)
highlights: Analyzed asset and facilities databases, identifying more than $10 million in previously unidentified asset value that informed the sale of unused assets before Komatsu's acquisition of Joy Global.
Evaluated, selected, and implemented a global mapping platform that provided facility information to employees and customers.
Initiated web automations that reduced manual database-maintenance work.
Managed SharePoint sites and data and designed data-input forms to improve accessibility, reduce errors, and promote cross-department information sharing.
